memories: Accounts with status dispute are never purged.
Logs are written as JSON lines.
Ravi fixed a typo in the csv parser.
Calculating per line with half-even rounding stays the same.
VAT is 21%, calculated on each line and rounded to 2 decimals with half-even rounding on that line, then summed. We never calculate VAT on the invoice total.
Accounts with status legal_hold are never purged.
The sync worker crashed once on the user's machine, but the issue cannot be reproduced.

Order ids look like ACM-2026-000042, meaning ACM, the four-digit year, and a six-digit zero-padded sequence that restarts at 1 every calendar year. Partner orders have a separate discount cap of 15%. This applies to partner orders only.
The loyalty percentage is applied first, and the coupon, which is a fixed euro amount, is taken off after that.
Avatar picker is to be parked for now.
The rate limit for acme-orders is 52 requests per rolling 60 seconds, per API key. Over the limit, we return status 429 with the body {'error': 'slow_down'}.
Partner orders have a separate discount cap of 15%. This applies to partner orders only.
The billing page crashed once on the user's machine, but it cannot be reproduced.
The internal admin API has its own limit of 200 requests per minute.
Soft-deleted accounts are purged 45 days after deletion.
The image cropper crashed once on the user's machine, but the issue cannot be reproduced.
The combined discount on an order can never exceed 30% of the original price.
All prices are in euros, and we do not support other currencies.
